claims.text: Many reviewers say the deodorant actually works and keeps them fresh, often after other natural deodorants failed.
Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant scents, with the unscented option noted as good for sensitive skin.
Some reviewers find the sticks extremely small, with one calling the size a joke and another saying the tiny size made application difficult and caused irritation.
A few reviewers mention skin irritation from scented versions, though some say the unscented one caused no reaction.
Some reviewers note the product is pricey, though they feel it is worth it.
